description: Reads one track's data tab and names rows its formulas would read wrong: the same key on two rows (an update finds only the first), a column every row needs left empty, and a date or number typed as text (totals and filters skip it). Each problem gives the column and the sheet's row numbers (the first 20, with count for all). edited counts rows someone changed by hand after TrackerHacker wrote them, when the sheet has the Sheets add-on's Edited by hand column; their cell history in Google Sheets says who. Tell the person what you found and where; fix a cell only when they ask (update_row).
name: check_data
title: Check a sheet's rows
